query GetTicks($input: GetTicksInput!) {
    ticks(input: $input) {
      uuid
      climbUuid
      angle
      isMirror
      status
      attemptCount
      quality
      effectiveQuality
      difficulty
      boardseshDifficulty
      boardseshConfidence
      isBenchmark
      comment
      climbedAt
      upvotes
      downvotes
      commentCount
    }
  }
